about:
RW Garcia operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it was founded more than three decades ago. The company began with a simple mission to create snacks using recognizable, non-GMO ingredients, though the exact founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces a range of gluten-free crackers and corn chips, all certified USDA Organic and Non-GMO Project Verified. Its cracker line includes varieties such as Sweet Potato, Lentil Turmeric, Sweet Beet, Kale, Sea Salt, Everything, and Parmesan Garlic, while its corn chips come in Yellow Corn, Chili Cheese, Bar-B-Q, and Blue Corn flavors. Manufacturing details such as facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

RW Garcia serves the retail and direct-to-consumer channels, distributing through grocery stores and its own online shop. Its products target the snack food, organic food, and gluten-free food markets, appealing to consumers seeking cleaner ingredient labels.

The brand emphasizes that its snacks are made with "real ingredients you can pronounce," positioning its non-GMO, organic, and gluten-free credentials as core differentiators in a crowded snack aisle.
